t: The $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ will pick up item entities in the world and put them into its inventory. Keep in mind that any $(l:programming/area)Area/$ widgets connected to this widget must have an area type of $(thing)Box/$; this is only supported shape. It's possible to create more complex shapes, though, by using whitelisting/blacklisting of multiple areas.
$(l:tools/drone)雄蜂/$会拾取世界中的物品实体，并将其放入自身容器。请记住，连接到此部件的任何$(l:programming/area)区域/$部件都必须将区域类型设为$(thing)盒子/$；这是唯一受支持的形状。不过，你也可以通过对白名单/黑名单中的多个区域进行组合，来创建更复杂的形状。

You can add an $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filter/$ widget to limit which items can be picked up (remember, a blacklist filter is placed on the $(thing)left/$).$(p)This widget is done executing when no items lying on the ground (which pass the item filter) can fit in the Drone's inventory or when there are no items left to pick up.
你可以添加一个$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$组件，以限制可拾取哪些物品（记住，黑名单过滤器放在$(thing)左侧/$）。$(p)当地面上没有符合物品过滤器条件且能放入无人机容器的物品，或已经没有任何可拾取的物品时，这个组件就会执行完毕。
